subject.title: feat(diagnostics-otel): identify each instance with service.instance.id

question: Should diagnostics-otel accept a new `OTEL_SERVICE_INSTANCE_ID` plus hostname fallback contract, or should this wait for the canonical OpenClaw resource-identity design in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/93071?
rationale: The code change is small, but the durable identity source, privacy expectation, and env/config contract are product/API choices that source inspection cannot safely decide.

options.title: Align With Canonical Identity Design
options.body: Remove the custom env variable and hostname fallback, then implement instance identity through the standard OTel resource path or the maintainer-approved identity seam from the canonical issue.

options.title: Adopt The New Env Contract
options.body: Maintainers can intentionally accept `OTEL_SERVICE_INSTANCE_ID`, but docs, precedence, privacy expectations, and upgrade behavior should be explicit before merge.

options.title: Pause Or Close This Branch
options.body: Keep this PR paused or close it as not worth carrying until the canonical resource-identity issue settles the permanent contract.

recommendation.title: Align With Canonical Identity Design
recommendation.body: Remove the custom env variable and hostname fallback, then implement instance identity through the standard OTel resource path or the maintainer-approved identity seam from the canonical issue.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc has recent merged history in the diagnostics-otel OpenTelemetry migration and plugin service path, making them the best available routing candidate for the OTel contract decision.
